entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.14177 Of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue writ or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus declaring the inaction of the respondent No.2 in considering and disposing the application filed by the petitioners dated 24.03.2024 under section 3G (H) of National Highways Act for determination of compensation for acquired land in survey No.109 to an extent of 1210 Sq. yards situated at Kannala Village, Bellampally Mandal, Mancherial District for enhancement of compensation as arbitrary and illegal and at the same time the respondent No.2 allowed the number of applications filed for enhancement under the same notification is nothing but showing the discrimination in similarly situated persons and thereby violated the Articles 14 and 16 of Constitution of India and consequently to direct the respondent No.2 to consider the application dated 24.03.2024 and to pay the enhanced compensation to the petitioner and to pass..."
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.
With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.
Learned Government Pleader for the respondents submits that the respondents will consider the application filed by the petitioner on 24.03.2024 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

4. In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondent No.2 to dispose of the application filed by the petitioner on 24.03.2024 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law within three (3)
months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date: 07.06.2024 BB Chityala Ramesh vs The State Of Telangana on 7 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176792839/
